# Youssef Jalloul

> AI entrepreneur and tech venture builder with 20+ years of experience. Builds private, local and governed enterprise AI for boards, executives and governments in Australia, the Gulf and Europe. Founder and CEO of Inova AI Solutions (2024 to now). MBA, Monash University. Based in Sydney and Dubai. Writes The AI Glittch newsletter.

Point of view: AI is too important to rent. If it runs your company, it should live in your house, follow your rules and speak your language. Machine-readable brand spec: https://youssefjalloul.com/genome.json

## Products and ventures
- [BLDR](https://youssefjalloul.com/ventures.html#bldr), "The AI Factory", built by Inova AI Solutions: BLDR is the sovereign AI operating system. Governments and enterprises use it to build, govern and run AI agents across the systems they already own, on-premise, in-country or in a private cloud, with human approvals, data classes, versioned policies and audit trails, in Arabic and English. Reported results: sales admin work down 82%, sales cycle down 34%, education engagement up 312%. BLDR is Youssef's main vehicle for local, sovereign, governed enterprise AI.
- Inova AI Solutions (Founder and CEO, 2024 to now; Sydney and Dubai): enterprise AI consultancy and home of BLDR; 200+ AI agents and proofs of concept; 20x internal engineering productivity.
- Gus (https://www.higus.ai, live): an AI employee that works inside a service business's WhatsApp.
- Ikraa (AI version launching soon): award-winning Arabic literacy software; 7,000+ learners taught to read and write in under 36 hours.
- A healthcare AI product for clinics is in stealth.
- *.Technology (Managing Partner, 2005 to 2020): 150+ digital transformation programmes across government, education, banking and insurance.
- Torch Academy (Board member and GM, 2015–2020): digital accelerator backed by the Central Bank of Lebanon.
- Exits: Toko · Beat2Beat (CMO, Feb 2020 to Apr 2022, exited; backed by INSEAD Launchpad, Station F, 10x, the French Ministry of the Economy and La French Tech) and VIP Rescue (co-founder and GM, 2016 to 2021, exited).
